notes.title: Yestermorrow OST - Available now!
notes.content:
Hello, time travellers!

We're happy to say that you can now get the YesterMorrow soundtrack with all 10 tracks! The whole OST was created by composer Grand Beats, and it is 24 minutes long.

You can get the game and the soundtrack in a bundle, but if you're into video games music, you can purchase it separately from the game as well!

We hope you enjoy listening to it!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21660/YesterMorrow_Game__Soundtrack/

notes.title: Happy ho-ho-holidays!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy ho-ho-holidays, travelers![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36808015/65333e8fd7680252e6641e9c09d2da3b8f2fd4f2.png[/img]

By Everlight, what's this? It looks like Yui's hometown village has been decorated for the holidays!

We're excited to announce that the YesterMorrow Christmas event is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36808015/b0fbbb06859403857668a930d6357ec47be2000b.png[/img]

From a newly decorated title screen, to snow and garlands around the houses in Yui's village, to your own Christmas tree! This update will make sure that you start feeling festive!

Just make sure to update your game to get all of this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36808015/633633d4f48d723ff7ac987f1cdf6c034da9ad44.png[/img]

[h2]Get YesterMorrow now![/h2]

If you haven't tried the game yet, now is the time for it! Not only you will get the Christmas update, but the game is also currently on sale! So you can get it with 35% off!

[b]YesterMorrow[/b] is a single-player time travelling 2D platformer, mixing action sequences with puzzle elements, all wrapped up in an engaging story about our young hero, Yui, who must save her family and to change the fate of a world that has been plunged into endless night.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210490/YesterMorrow/

notes.title: Activities in China
notes.content:
[b]大家期待已久的《昨日未来》终于要上线啦！撒花~[/b]
这次我们诚邀谜叔（b站@谜之声   微博@什么谜之声被抢注了）在今天19:00为大家带来提前试玩。
直播地址：https://live.bilibili.com/117
这款由斯洛伐克工作室开发的动作解谜冒险游戏，也是融入了不少东方的元素，想看看老外眼里的东方风是什么样的么？那我们今天就相约谜叔的直播间，不见不散吧！



[b]另外，活动上线后也将开启主播的速通调整！[/b]
具体请看：http://link.bilibili.com/p/eden/news#/newsDetail?id=1532

极速未来由你创造：《昨日未来》速通比赛

【活动时间】
11月6日10:00至11月13日24:00

【活动规则】

主播需在单机-独立游戏 分区直播，且挑战全程需直播，且直播间标题有【昨日未来】

成绩计算：通关游戏，击败最后的boss——宗师，确认通关时长。根据通关时长决定排名。（通关时间越短排名越靠前）

时间统计：以直播录像的时间换算为准。录制视频时必须直播，全程需窗口化游戏，显示出左下角的时间。
如果分段直播，可剪辑视频为一个视频，但是上次游戏结束和下次游戏开始的画面必须一致，不允许剪辑正式通关的画面，一经发现取消资格。


成绩确认：需要将个人ID、截图（截图需要切换到桌面截下当时的时间）和直播录像地址投稿至邮箱contact@gameragame.com ，请在B站投稿直播录像。

【活动奖励】
第一名 小电视x1
第二~三名 摩天大楼x1
第四~十名 天空之翼 x1

【活动细则】
1、允许反复刷新成绩，但只允许提交一次投稿成绩至邮箱，以投稿成绩为准，且需标明成绩产生时间。（如多次提交成绩至邮箱，以首次提交的成绩为准。）
2、如果通关时间相同，将以成绩产生时间（视频投稿时间）决定排名前后。
3、禁止使用任何修改软件，包括但不限于CE、加速精灵等，一经发现直接取消成绩。
4、直播和视频缺一不可，不允许只投稿视频不直播，不允许剪辑视频内游戏通关的过程。
5、如无特殊要求，结束时间以当日24点为准。
6、奖品将会在公示结束后五个工作日内进行发放，发放时需要在进行游玩【昨日未来】。
7、成绩统计完之后会有七日公示时间，如有异议请在公示期内提出，过时不候。
8、如果成绩出现争议，将会调取直播录像，并请出现争议的选手提供具体的直播时间段。若选手无法提供，判定为成绩无效。
9、本活动成绩计算、排名判定的最终解释权归GameraGame所有。

notes.title: YesterMorrow Community Chat
notes.content:
Ask the devs any questions you have about YesterMorrow, a single-player time travelling 2D platformer, mixing action sequences with puzzle elements. The game is about a young hero, Yui, who sets out on a journey into the past to save her family and to change the fate of a world that has been plunged into endless night. This can only be done by repairing the mysterious Clocktower controlling the cycle of time.

Click [url=https://discord.gg/K3BvKqx]here[/url] to join the Discord server!
